text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, a photography crew came to snap 
some photos of daily life for the academy 
brochure, but...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, just keep it natural, please~ 
Don't stiffen up, just walk slowly~.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yup. 'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Please feel free to enjoy your meal just 
as you normally would—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♪ Fufu, isn't this delicious, 
Zephyr-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. It is a gentle south wind.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna take some videos of training~ 
...Oh, but first—"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I just can't help but wonder. Why do 
you wear your racing outfit all day long?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Was it no good? Since we were taking 
photos, I thought making it memorable 
would be nice."

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that it's bad, but today's theme 
is everyday scenes, so a racing outfit 
stands out a bit too much—"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter, Trainer-san? Do you 
need something from Machan?
choice_data_list: Don't get in the way of the shoot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I didn't mean to get in your way, you 
know? I just wanted you to take a photo of 
Ma-chan in her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Because I designed this racing outfit 
specifically so that anyone who sees it 
will never forget it."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"When designing her racewear, Machan 
thought about it a whole, whole lot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to eye-catching colors, red 
comes first. Red is perfect for the lovely 
Chan-me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Ma-chan is going to be an ultra 
super mascot in the future, so dignity is 
very important. Yes, a crown.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And this fluffy skirt is the perfect 
length to bring out Chan-mee's cuteness 
the most."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And thus, Mascot Chan obtained the most 
lovely and memorable racewear ever. Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems a lot of ingenuity went into her 
Racing Strips to make sure people 
"remember her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then, the large red ribbon that 
stood out against her prized skirt caught 
my eye.
choice_data_list: Does that ribbon have a meaning too, then?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of you, Trainer. The 
ribbon on the skirt, the ribbon on the 
chest—ribbons are the detail I care about 
most.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The ribbon connects Machan and everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Tie it tight into everyone's memories... 
so that no one will ever forget Chan-Mee.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll tie them together, lots and lots of 
them. Chan-Maru's ribbons, together with 
everyone—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her eyes were filled with extraordinary 
resolve. Her actions weren't merely to 
stand out. If that's the case—"
choice_data_list: Let's train in our racing outfit today!

I'll save it for when it'll truly get 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course. And if all goes well, Chan-Mei 
might even make her debut in the brochure 
as the academy's official mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
After all, she is the lovely Chan-me. We 
can't rule out the possibility of other 
requests, so—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, look, look.

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you have a moment? I'd like to take 
a photo for another page—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan seized the opportunity 
through her own strength. I watched her, 
feeling how dependable she had become.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Indeed. You got me there-chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
People remember you best when you win 
races. I see, I see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it'd be bad to get it 
dirty, so I'll go change. Off I go-chan."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her back as she dashed off saying 
that, a vivid vision suddenly crossed my 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day when everyone will burn the memory 
of her shining brightest into their minds. 
I resolved to give it my all for that day, 
which will surely come.
